_comment: Production: replace localhost URLs, Mongo connection, JWT secret, and internal service key with real environment-specific values before deployment.

Mongo._comment: Production: use the MongoDB Atlas connection string and production database name.

Jwt._comment: Production: set this to the same auth JWT secret used by auth-service.

EventService._comment: Production: point this to the deployed event-service URL.

NotificationService._comment: Production: point this to the deployed notification-service URL and real internal service key.

Cors._comment: Production: replace localhost with the deployed frontend origin(s).
